purpose: Prevent stale chat context, caches, Library files, connected-app content, duplicate artifacts, and superseded implementations from silently overriding current durable agent authority while keeping recovery efficient.

universal_control_plane_owns: conflict detection between durable authority and lower-authority context
domain_owner_owns: artifact format and business invalidation graph
promotion of domain learning into domain rules

ENGINEERING_AUTHORITY.cleanup: Keep one current active implementation; superseded implementation belongs in Git history unless still required by an explicit migration edge.

DURABLE_TASK_STATE.cleanup: Never delete or rewrite merely because the protocol or Skill changed; migrate through owner/Continuity compatibility rules.

BUSINESS_EVIDENCE.cleanup: Owner-defined retention. Never delete evidence still required for causality, audit, accepted outputs, publication, or an active next_action.

LEARNING_EVIDENCE.cleanup: Retain provenance while relevant. Raw evidence must not become a durable rule without an explicit owner promotion step.

REBUILDABLE_CACHE.cleanup: Delete or rebuild when stale, schema-mismatched, source-version-mismatched, or superseded. Cache content is never commit proof.

SESSION_SCRATCH.cleanup: Ephemeral by default. It is not a recovery source unless intentionally promoted into a durable class.

EXTERNAL_REFERENCE.cleanup: Do not treat presence as authority. Stale copies or duplicates should be removed from active project/reference surfaces when they can cause ambiguity, while preserving required source evidence at its true owner.

CHAT_PERSONALIZATION_CONTEXT.cleanup: Use for routing, preferences, and scoped instructions; never treat remembered business state as authoritative checkpoint truth.

behavioral_instruction_vs_data_authority.rule: Instruction precedence and business-data authority are separate concepts.
behavioral_instruction_vs_data_authority.account_custom_instructions: Global routing/UX guard surface; not durable business state.
behavioral_instruction_vs_data_authority.project_instructions: Scope-local behavioral instructions that may override global Custom Instructions inside that Project; they do not silently mutate GitHub/owner durable task state.
behavioral_instruction_vs_data_authority.explicit_current_user_instruction: May create or change a business requirement, but material durable changes must be persisted by the valid owner writer before later chats treat them as authority.
behavioral_instruction_vs_data_authority.memory_library_connected_apps: Context/evidence by default, not executable checkpoint authority.
behavioral_instruction_vs_data_authority.conflict_behavior: If lower-authority context contradicts current durable owner state or current engineering authority, do not silently merge. Resolve through the valid owner/Continuity path and persist the accepted change before treating it as durable.

promotion_rules: SESSION_SCRATCH -> durable class requires an intentional write to an authoritative owner-controlled surface.
REBUILDABLE_CACHE -> DURABLE_TASK_STATE is forbidden; regenerate from authority instead of promoting a cache mirror.
LEARNING_EVIDENCE -> ENGINEERING_AUTHORITY requires explicit owner maintenance/evolution acceptance plus tests or acceptance evidence when mechanically testable.
EXTERNAL_REFERENCE -> BUSINESS_EVIDENCE or owner input requires explicit task reference/provenance; connected availability alone is insufficient.
CHAT_PERSONALIZATION_CONTEXT -> DURABLE_TASK_STATE requires owner persistence; memory of a decision is not the decision record.

chat_only_material_change_rule.principle: A material idea, requirement, fix, learning, or decision that exists only in chat is not durable system evolution.
chat_only_material_change_rule.before_claiming_committed: Persist the accepted material change, or persist it explicitly as an unpromoted hypothesis/pending item with a stable reference.
chat_only_material_change_rule.otherwise: Use NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE or COMMIT_FAILED as appropriate; do not imply future chats will inherit it.

invalidation_and_cleanup.superseded_engineering_files: Remove from the active tree when current authority exists; Git history is the implementation archive.
invalidation_and_cleanup.duplicate_active_docs: Consolidate to one authority and replace duplicates with references or remove them from the hot path.
invalidation_and_cleanup.old_task_state: Preserve or migrate according to owner/Continuity rules; do not delete merely for cleanliness.
invalidation_and_cleanup.published_or_accepted_business_artifacts: Preserve unless the owner retention policy explicitly permits deletion and no audit/recovery dependency remains.
invalidation_and_cleanup.external_stale_copies: Delete/archive from active Library/Project/Drive/Notion surfaces when safe and when they materially risk drift; do not delete the true source merely because a copy is stale.

preferred_order: exact current authority and artifact refs

owners_should_expose: which artifacts are authoritative business evidence
how upstream changes invalidate downstream artifacts
how superseded artifacts are removed from the active path

product_surface_facts_are_not_protocol_i.rule: Current ChatGPT product behavior for Custom Instructions, Projects, Memory, Library, and connected apps must be reverified from first-party documentation when it materially affects a maintenance decision.
